title: centaurea spinosociliata subsp. tommasinii
intro: Centaurea spinosociliata subsp. tommasinii, commonly known as Spiny Cockscomb or Tommasini's Spiny Thistle, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) characterized by its distinctive spiny leaves and showy, pinkish-red flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating various ailments such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea spinosociliata subsp. tommasinii include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential as a natural remedy for pain relief and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
